battle_start.text: You want my bridge? Come and take it! Come on, I'll wait!
Look at them! Fat valley folk, all this way just to bleed!
Every child who starved in the hills is watching you. Make it a good show!
battle_start.direction: the swagger cracks; real anger underneath

battle_start.text: Host! Up, up! The valley's come visiting!

hit.text: Ha! Feel that? That's three winters of hunger!
Again! Do it again, I dare you to stand up!

miss.text: Lucky! Stay lucky, valley folk. It won't last!

crit.text: That's for the little ones! Every single one!
Down you go! Down where we've been all along!

kill.text: See? Taking works. Asking never fed anybody.
kill.direction: flat, almost to himself, then loud again

ally_down.text: Get up! Nobody lies down on my bridge!

low_hp.text: Ha! Ha ha! Is that all? My grandmother hits harder!
You think blood scares me? I was born hungry!

victory.text: Go home and tell them! The bridge is Vorga's!
Run back to your mayor. Tell him to open his granaries, or we come for them.

defeat.text: Ha. Ha. Fine. You win the bridge. You don't win the winter.
Not like this. Not to them.
